text:
Dear all,
I am currently conducting a research project as part of my coursework for 𝐏𝐇𝐑𝟓𝟐𝟎: 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 at 𝐍𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐡 𝐒𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡 𝐔𝐧𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐲. The title of my project is:
"𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐀𝐭𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐓𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐃𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐠𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐲 𝐀𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐁𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐢 𝐖𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐧."
To support this study, I am kindly requesting your help in completing a short 𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐲. It will take only a few minutes of your time and your responses will be completely used solely for academic purposes.
 Survey Link: https://docs.google.com/.../1FAIpQLScSp.../viewform...
I need at least 𝟏𝟎𝟎 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐬, so your participation would be greatly appreciated. If you know someone who fits the criteria, feel free to share it with them as well.
Thank you for your valuable time and support ! See less
